messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock the Private Deploy scope for the next 2 sprints. Field pressure around VPC handshakes, upgrade rollback behavior, and a minimal offline installer. I sketched a proposed sprint split and launch gates, PTAL.

sam: +1. Important we define rollback window and how operator upgrades can be reverted without tenant impact. field asks for a 30m max failover window. Is that feasible?

morgan: From customers: main asks = 1) preserve existing egress IPs during upgrades, 2) clear BGP peering fallback, 3) small installer tarball for locked-down environments. They also want a clear comms template for scheduled upgrades.

lee: Re: IP preservation — we can do egress-affinity by default but need to expose a knob for netops to opt-out. BGP fallback needs an explicit degrade path: relay -> nat -> fallback-peers. We'll need docs + tests for each.

sam: Implementation note: installer presets should include a zero-touch "relay-only" mode and an "operator-managed" mode. Example flags: 
```
--install-mode=relay-only|operator
--preserve-egress=true|false
```
Will add a size target: < 200MB for airgap bundle.

morgan: Prioritization from field: (A) egress IP preservation + comms, (B) relay fallback, (C) slim airgap bundle. Customers with compliance needs will only accept A and C together.

anya: Proposed launch gates: 
- Gate 1 (internal alpha): operator upgrade + rollback validated on staging (no tenant loss)
- Gate 2 (field beta): egress-preserve + comms template delivered to 3 customers
- Gate 3 (GA): airgap installer < 200MB, KMS/HSM integration, SLA wording finalized
These are draft — want engineering & field buy-in.

lee: For Gate 1 we need automated canary that verifies KV cache integrity post-upgrade. Suggest a canary job that runs after every operator roll.

sam: I can add the canary job; will need a small runtime metric: "kv-hit-rate-after-upgrade" and an alert if it drops > 15% in 10m. Also: rollback choreography pseudo: 
```
1) pause new requests to target pool
2) switch routing to fallback variant
3) revert operator deployment
4) warm caches from preserved prefix
```
We should document sequence and expected RTO.

morgan: Field asks to include a comms snippet for customers with peering: short notice + prep steps + rollback expectations. I can draft and attach to the beta handoff.

anya: Owners: sam -> upgrade automation & canary; lee -> networking fallback design; morgan -> customer comms + beta orchestration. I'll own acceptance criteria and launch gating.

ops-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/private-deploy/sprint-scope-1791122334 (visibility: product, eng, field).

sam: One open Q: telemetry for onprem — we need minimal heartbeat + install fingerprint for offline installs. Any privacy constraints?

morgan: Customers will accept heartbeat if its opt-in and only contains anonymized runtime metrics. We'll track that in the data-handling checklist.

anya: Ok — next steps: sam to draft canary & rollback runbook by EOD Wed, lee to post network fallback diagram, morgan to prep comms draft. We'll take a gating review Fri 10:30am PT. If anything blocks, drop it in this thread. :thumbsup:

lee: noted. Will prototype fallback in a small lab this week.

sam: will spin up the canary job and share logs sample in thread.

morgan: I'll book the beta customers and share the timeline.

anya: Thanks team. Keeping scope tight here is critical — aim to deliver A+B in sprint 1, C in sprint 2.
